title: Fix lots of spellings
description:
Created by running Darius's script from
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14353
that finds and fixes common mispellings from
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Lists_of_common_misspellings/For_machines

Could teach tools/check-spelling.py not to accept these words too.

commits_data.message:
Fix lots of spellings

Created by running Darius's script from
https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14353
that finds and fixes common mispellings from
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Lists_of_common_misspellings/For_machines

Could teach tools/check-spelling.py not to accept these words too.
